specification.title: Cycles between domain and IP never repeat work
specification.description: domain -> IP -> domain -> IP never repeats equivalent execution.
specification.purpose: Verify domain-to-IP-to-domain cycles never repeat equivalent execution while the IP pivot still completes.
specification.operational_relevance: Cyclic relationships between domains and resolved IPs are routine; cycle suppression is what guarantees termination in real graphs.
specification.regression_risk: The coordinator could re-execute the domain or IP after the cycle returns.

required: The resolved-IP pivot executes exactly once
forbidden: The root domain is re-pivoted after the IP cycle returns to it
